title: Normalized tensor, adjunction and projection comparison squares
statement: For four monoidal categories $B,E,F,H$ [def-sfb-monoidal-category], functors $L:B\to E$, $L\prime:F\to H$, $S:B\to F$, $T:E\to H$ with specified strong monoidal structures [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], and $i:TL\cong L\prime S$, define TensorSquare to mean that the two composites from $TL(X\otimes Y)$ to $L\prime SX\otimes L\prime SY$ using $i$ and the specified tensorators agree, for all $X,Y$. Given adjunctions $L\dashv R$, $L\prime\dashv R\prime$ and $j:SR\cong R\prime T$, define ProjectionSquare to mean that the counit-transpose projection maps commute with $i,j$ and the tensorators of $S,T$, for all inputs; projection maps are the existing adjunction-transpose construction. Finally, for Grothendieck abelian monoidal coefficient categories [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with their K-flat total tensors [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso], and an additive exact coproduct-preserving strong monoidal functor $G$ with specified monoidal structure on $D(G)$, define TensorNormalization to be the commuting localization square for its tensorator on every two K-flat complexes: the localization tensor map, termwise $G$ comparison, and signed direct-sum total comparison are the canonical ones. AdjunctionSquare records equality of the full Hom bijections, units and counits under $i,j$. NormalizedComparison packages these squares with specified localization and tensor normalizations.
